title: COPY EXTENDED DATA TO ANOTHER VOLUME FILE
description: This command copies the information in a volume file that isn't a critical part of the standard header or data matrix, e.g. map names, palette settings, label tables.  If -drop-unknown is not specified, it also copies similar kinds of information set by other software.

data_volume.description: the volume file containing the voxel data to use

extension_volume.description: the volume file containing the extensions to use

drop_unknown.description: don't copy extensions that workbench doesn't understand
